description: This file defines the Gdpr model class for handling GDPR-related database operations in the Opencart system, including adding, updating, and retrieving GDPR records.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Model class for GDPR data management within the Opencart account module.

methods.name: addGdpr
methods.description: Creates a new GDPR record in the database with provided code, email, and action.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdprByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its unique code.

methods.name: getGdprsByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves all GDPR records associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records with status 'processing' that are expired based on date_added and configured limit.
